items.question: How many years is a UAE Green visa residence permit valid for before renewal?
items.gold: A renewable residence visa valid for 5 years.
items.fact: Green visa residence valid 5 years, renewable.

items.question: Which categories of individuals are eligible for the UAE Green visa?
items.gold: Skilled workers, freelancers and self-employed, and investors and business partners.
items.fact: Green visa eligible categories: skilled workers, freelancers, investors.
